name: Daniel Tagansky
headline: I Help 6-7 Figure Medical Professionals Double Booked Consults Without The Wait, The Lock-In, Or The Guesswork
about:
I co-founded RevRoute because I kept watching service businesses lose money in the same two ways half-empty calendars, or leads slipping through the cracks because no one followed up fast enough.

So we built the fix.

Here's what we do for service businesses:
→ Custom Next.js websites built to convert, not just look good
→ Meta ads + landing pages that turn ad spend into booked appointments
→ AI-powered DM automation that responds 24/7 across IG, Facebook, and TikTok

If your calendar needs filling, let's connect.
… more

experiences.description:
I run the client-facing side of RevRoute: sales, onboarding, client relationships, and go-to-market strategy. If you talk to RevRoute, you're talking to me. My co-founder Nathan handles the build.

Everything we do is fully managed. You don't build anything, you don't answer messages, you don't touch the tech. We handle it all and you show up to the appointments we book you.

NetSuite configurations and system enhancements to drive business efficiency and scale operations. 

Strategic consulting alongside the SuiteLabs team on SuiteCommerce engagements for e-commerce clients running on NetSuite.

Photo and video production for small businesses, weddings, sororities, and organizations across the Midwest. 

Every project end-to-end: concept, shoot, edit, deliver. Drone footage, event coverage, product shoots, and social-first video.
